description: Get 24h notional volume per outcome side coin from the Hyperliquid WS feed. Pass coins from hl_outcomes sides[].coin, e.g. ["#143150","#143151"]. Returns { coin: volume } for coins that reported; a missing coin means no reading (not zero). Prefer hl_outcomes withVolume=true, which reports coverage per market.
name: get_hl_outcome_volumes
